Attached file: quarterly-ops.txt
[file content begins]
Quarterly operations report, section 4.
Revenue this quarter: ₹12,34,567.
Costs this quarter: ₹8,00,120.
[file content ends]
When quoting a figure from the material, keep its exact digits and digit grouping. When restating a figure in different units or a different grouping convention, state the exact conversion being applied and verify the restated figure has the same value; never give two versions of one figure that have different values.

chat.answer:
**Revenue this quarter: ₹1,234,567** (international grouping, same ₹ crore/lakh-free rupee unit).

- Original as quoted: **₹12,34,567** — Indian convention, groups of 2 digits after the leading 3.
- Regrouping applied: digits are unchanged (1 2 3 4 5 6 7); only the comma positions move to 3-digit groups from the right.
- Verification: 12 × 100,000 + 34 × 1,000 + 567 = 1,200,000 + 34,000 + 567 = **1,234,567**, and 1,234,567 = 1,234 × 1,000 + 567 = **₹1,234,567**. Same value, no scaling, so it is also still ₹12.34567 lakh.
